visual_requirements.description: one male human head, two arms; three-pronged trident, opaque Roman robe covering chest
trident smashes rock and raises waves and storms

aura: Kesan kuasa dari aksi fisik/atribut: trident smashes rock and raises waves and storms (neptune-c05), bukan aura generik.
artistic_choices: Framing, foreshortening, warna dan pakaian buram adalah pilihan editorial; tidak menambah anatomi atau kekuatan.
Beard/age editorial; documented trident, sea and rock effects.

A.prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mythics illustration of Neptune, Roman sea god.
ANATOMY: one male human head, two arms; three-pronged trident, opaque Roman robe covering chest [neptune-c05, neptune-c06, neptune-c27]
MOMENT: Strike foreground reef with three-pronged trident in both hands, wet robe whipping, waves rear behind brow, rocks crack
POWER: trident smashes rock and raises waves and storms [neptune-c05]
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low camera; tight framing and strong foreshortening; subject fills most of square, no invented giant size.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one storm light through cloud; high contrast rim light and deep shadows.
SURFACE: tangible skin or fur, weathered opaque cloth and stone; dark walnut and antique gold palette with one accent.
SETTING: sea and sharp-edged reef [neptune-c28]
MOOD: overwhelming imposing majesty and determined expression, active awe inspiring presence, never ordinary or decorative; respectful living religious deity if applicable.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text anywhere including clothes and stones, NO pseudo glyphs, painted forehead symbols, lettering, signature, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads, limbs or fingers; no film/game/anime/comic design; fully opaque clothing covering the whole torso whenever clothed, no nudity, no explicit gore, no generic glow aura, neon outline, energy ribbons or runes. Entire head and attributes remain in frame. Cloth ornaments only plain weaving or geometric patterns, no writing.
